units: All scores and differences are fractions, not percentages or percentage points.

bootstrap.unit: validation participant ID, stratified within each of six classes
bootstrap.seed_aggregation: Compute F1 separately for each fixed model seed, then average; no probability ensemble or pooled-seed pseudoreplication.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted models and fixed development partitions. Preserves observed class priors. CNR is one export and SUMO has three monitor episodes; no scene-level or training-uncertainty inference. Exploratory comparisons, no multiplicity correction.

sumo-duration/full/gaf.scope: Duration-matched SUMO sensitivity cohort: point estimates only; not paired to random SUMO or CNR vehicle IDs.

cnr/grid_xy-minus-xy.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

cnr/native_h-minus-grid_xy.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

cnr/squeezed_h-minus-native_h.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

cnr/unit_h-minus-squeezed_h.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

cnr/gaf-minus-unit_h.interpretation: Different readout architectures: ImageNet ResNet18 versus SequenceClassifier; not pure encoding loss.

sumo/grid_xy-minus-xy.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

sumo/native_h-minus-grid_xy.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

sumo/squeezed_h-minus-native_h.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

sumo/unit_h-minus-squeezed_h.interpretation: Same readout architecture and paired IDs; representation/interpolation and readout difficulty can all affect scores.

sumo/gaf-minus-unit_h.interpretation: Different readout architectures: ImageNet ResNet18 versus SequenceClassifier; not pure encoding loss.

full.scope: CNR minus SUMO, matched class counts; different source populations, not a paired or causal source effect.

window512.scope: CNR minus SUMO, matched class counts; different source populations, not a paired or causal source effect.

cnr.scope: Full-trained/full-input versus window-trained/window-input GAF on common validation IDs; training populations and input spans both change, not a pure duration effect.

sumo.scope: Full-trained/full-input versus window-trained/window-input GAF on common validation IDs; training populations and input spans both change, not a pure duration effect.
